2. **The undeclared-media-type check:** it timed out at its default 30-second limit. My six new routes make this check slightly longer. It needs a time limit based on a measured run.

All my own files pass in the full run: the connector tests (20/20), the contract test (101/101, with the request-body count pin raised from 397 to 403) and the demo tests. Typecheck, build, lint, prettier, the OpenAPI lint and `pnpm test` (with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8) all exit 0 on the final code.

What's still needed is a clean full integration run of the merged tree on an unloaded machine. I've updated the handback with these results and the end time, 02:33:14Z. All changes are still uncommitted.
